title: Coefficient-unit square for a fixed normalized realization comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite-field datum D, a FamilyCore C, geometric spaces T,U over D, and a scheme isomorphism g:T.base.left ≅ U.base.left [def-sf-adic-realization-isomorphism-data]. Assume integralRealizationAgreement for C.comparison T U g at every finite coefficient index E, using C.integral T U g E and C.ring T U g. No normalization at any other scheme isomorphism is assumed. Put X=T.base.left, Y=U.base.left, J_X=ordinary(l,X,(C.data T).realization), J_Y=ordinary(l,Y,(C.data U).realization), P=commonStageDerivedPullback(l,PadicAlgCl(l),g.hom), G=derivedPull(l,X,g.hom,C.ring T U g), a=C.comparison T U g, and V=C.pullTensor T U g. Use the invertibility instances from C.data. Let 1_Y=pullbackTensorCommonUnit(l,PadicAlgCl(l),Y), u_Y=(C.data U).tensor.unit.hom and u_X=(C.data T).tensor.unit.hom. Let v=(C.unit_spec T U g).exists.choose be the very unit isomorphism selected by its canonicalCommonStagePullbackTensor_unit witness; let w=pullUnit(l,X,g.hom,V). Then G.map(u_Y) ≫ a.inv.app(1_Y) ≫ J_X.map(v.hom) = w.hom ≫ u_X. This asserts only the coefficient-unit square for the specified unit witnesses, with no tensor, identity, composition or Hom law assumed for a.

proof.text: Represent the coefficient unit by the degree-zero coefficient complex at a finite coefficient field. The left-unit equation of At determines its unit arrow from the finite normalized tensorator and the prescribed source and ambient unitors: cancel the invertible tensorator after tensoring with the unit. Thus no arbitrary scalar rescaling of At.unit remains.

Substitute integralRealizationAgreement at this integral unit representative. Integral balanced pullback and reindexUnitSections identify the reindexing unit with the coefficient-ring map on degree-zero sections. Both coaugmentation routes send one to one at every quotient, with zero shifted-product coordinate, so the resulting cochain maps agree before localization. Their whole completion equality descends through the integral representative isomorphisms.

The left-unitor equation in C.unit_spec fixes precisely its chosen common-stage unit isomorphism v; cancel its invertible tensor comparison and left unitor. Apply ordinary realization and cancel the integral comparison and completion isomorphisms. Raw rationalization and inclusion transport the equality to the displayed coefficient-unit square. This calculation needs normalization only for the fixed map g.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_reindexing_unit_compatibility
    (C : FamilyCore l D) (T U : GeometricSpace D) (g : T.base.left ≅ U.base.left)
    (h_integral_normalization : ∀ (E : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l (PadicAlgCl l)),
        letI := (C.data T).units
        letI := (C.data U).units
        integralRealizationAgreement l g.hom (C.data T).realization (C.data U).realization
          (C.ring T U g) E (C.integral T U g E) (C.comparison T U g)) :
    letI := (C.data T).units
    letI := (C.data U).units
    (derivedPull l T.base.left g.hom (C.ring T U g)).map (C.data U).tensor.unit.hom ≫
      (C.comparison T U g).inv.app (pullbackTensorCommonUnit l (PadicAlgCl l) U.base.left) ≫
      (ordinary l T.base.left (C.data T).realization).map
        (C.unit_spec T U g).exists.choose.hom =
    (pullUnit l T.base.left g.hom (C.pullTensor T U g)).hom ≫ (C.data T).tensor.unit.hom
